Adds a smartphone item to Stardew Valley. Use it to chat with an AI assistant about crops, villagers, mines, quests, fishing, money tips, and more. The UI looks like a phone chat app.

Installation
1. Install SMAPI from https://smapi.io/
2. Extract this mod into your Stardew Valley Mods folder
  Path example: Mods/StardewAIPhone/
3. Launch the game with SMAPI

How to use
1. Load a save. You should get a smartphone automatically.
2. Select the phone and right-click to open chat.
3. If you have no phone, type this in the SMAPI console: aiphone_give
4. Edit Mods/StardewAIPhone/config.json for AI settings.

Local Ollama (free):
ApiBaseUrl = http://localhost:11434/v1
ApiKey = ollama
Model = qwen2.5:3b
Then run: ollama pull qwen2.5:3b

Cloud API example (DeepSeek):
ApiBaseUrl = https://api.deepseek.com
ApiKey = your-key
Model = deepseek-chat

After changing config, restart the game or type: aiphone_reload

Main features
- Smartphone inventory item
- In-game AI chat UI
- Quick question buttons
- Optional live farm context
- Chat history saved per save
- Supports Ollama or OpenAI-compatible APIs

Requirements
- Stardew Valley 1.6+
- SMAPI 4.0+
- Ollama or your own API key

Notes
This mod does not include an API key. Players must configure their own local model or cloud API. AI answers may be imperfect.

Shout outs
Thanks to Pathoschild and the SMAPI / Stardew modding community.[/color]
